.. change::
    :tags: bug, engine, typing
    :tickets: 13627

    The :class:`.ExceptionContext` interface now allows the documented
    modification of :attr:`.ExceptionContext.is_disconnect` and
    :attr:`.ExceptionContext.invalidate_pool_on_disconnect` in a
    :meth:`.DialectEvents.handle_error` handler to pass static type checks.
